description: Frontend: Feature 1 (Biomarker Trend Timeline in MedicalVault.jsx) + Feature 4 (Emergency QR in ProfileIdentity.jsx + new EmergencyCard page + App.jsx route). Both live in the Profile section and neither depends on dashboard changes from FEAT-002. Independent of FEAT-002.
steps:
STEP 2 — MedicalVault.jsx: Below the existing vault-list-container div, add a 'Biomarker Trend Timeline' section:
  - Toggle button: 'Biomarker Trend Timeline' (shows/hides section)
  - If no pathology records exist: empty state div with text 'No biomarker history available yet. Upload a lab report to start tracking trends.'
  - If data exists: biomarker dropdown <select> with one <option> per biomarker name
  - When selectedBiomarker is set, show trend panel:
    - Latest value, previous value, absolute change, percentage change, unit
    - Status label: compute direction. Use a safe-direction map: {glucose: 'lower=better', hba1c: 'lower=better', cholesterol: 'lower=better', ldl: 'lower=better', hdl: 'higher=better', hemoglobin: 'target-range'}. For glucose/hba1c/cholesterol/ldl: if latest < previous → 'Improving'; if latest > previous → 'Worsening'. For hdl: opposite. For all others or when direction ambiguous: 'Changed'. If only 1 data point → 'Stable'.
    - Pure SVG line chart: width 100%, height ~120px. Compute x positions as evenly spaced across width. Compute y positions scaled between min/max value. Draw a polyline connecting the points. Add dots at each data point. Add date labels at bottom (rotated if needed). No external library.
    - Medical disclaimer: 'Recorded values shown in chronological order. Direction labels reflect typical clinical conventions and do not constitute a diagnosis.'
    - Table of all data points: date, value, unit columns

STEP 3 — Create frontend/src/pages/EmergencyCard.jsx: Public page, no auth required. Uses useParams to get token from URL. On mount, fetch GET /api/emergency/{token}/ using plain axios (not the api instance with JWT). Show: MedFusion AI branding, Patient Name, Vault ID, Blood Group, Allergies (as badges), Emergency Contact, Active Medications (from active_meds list, show name+dosage), Last Updated date. Style with existing glass-card / font-monospace classes, plain dark background. Add clear red EMERGENCY header. Add disclaimer: 'This card is for emergency reference only. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider.' Handle 404 gracefully with a friendly error state.

STEP 4 — App.jsx: Import EmergencyCard from ./pages/EmergencyCard. Add route: <Route path='/emergency/:token' element={<EmergencyCard />} /> in the Routes section. This route needs no authentication wrapper.

STEP 5 — ProfileIdentity.jsx: Add Emergency QR section below the existing smartcard content (after the allergies section, before the bottom border). Add state managed from Profile.jsx: Since ProfileIdentity is a pure display component and Profile.jsx manages all state, add to Profile.jsx: emergencyToken state, handleGenerateToken, handleRevokeToken functions. Pass emergencyToken, onGenerateToken, onRevokeToken as props to ProfileIdentity. In Profile.jsx fetchProfile: also fetch /api/emergency/generate/ status — actually, add a separate fetchEmergencyToken() call on mount: GET is not available (no GET endpoint for current token). Instead, use a stored state: load from localStorage key 'medfusion_emergency_token_{userId}' as initial state. After generate/revoke update localStorage. Profile.jsx handleGenerateToken: POST /api/emergency/generate/ → store returned token in state and localStorage. Profile.jsx handleRevokeToken: DELETE /api/emergency/revoke/ → clear state and localStorage. In ProfileIdentity.jsx, add Emergency QR Card section: - If no emergencyToken: show 'Generate Emergency QR' button - If token: show QR code image via , 'Regenerate' button, 'Revoke' button, 'Download' button (opens QR URL in new tab) - Section label: 'Emergency QR Card' - Subtext: 'Scan to access emergency medical information without login required.' - Security note: 'Revoke at any time to invalidate the QR code.'
acceptance_criteria: MedicalVault.jsx shows 'Biomarker Trend Timeline' section below existing vault list
Dropdown populated with biomarker names from patient's pathology records
SVG line chart renders when a biomarker is selected and there are ≥2 data points
Empty state text shown when no pathology records exist
EmergencyCard.jsx created as a public route at /emergency/:token
EmergencyCard fetches and displays patient emergency data without JWT
ProfileIdentity.jsx shows Emergency QR section with Generate/Regenerate/Revoke buttons
QR code image displayed using api.qrserver.com when token exists
verification: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build 2>&1 (expect: built in X.Xs with no errors)
